## Create the folders

```{r create folders, eval=FALSE}

dir.create("output")
dir.create("figures")
dir.create("reports")

```

## Load necessary libraries

```{r libraries, include = FALSE}

library(here)        # To manage project file paths reproducibly
library(dplyr)       # For data manipulation and wrangling
library(VIM)         # For KNN imputation and visualization of missing data
library(gtsummary)   # To create publication-ready summary and regression tables
library(geepack)     # For generalized estimating equations (GEE) models
library(pROC)        # For ROC curve analysis and AUC calculation
library(rbounds)     # For Rosenbaum sensitivity analysis in matched studies
library(tidyr)       # For reshaping and tidying data
library(labelled)    # To manage variable labels and metadata
library(MatchIt)     # For propensity score matching
library(cobalt)      # To assess covariate balance and create Love plots
```

## 1 Import data

```{r import, include = TRUE}

Outcome <- read.csv(
  here("data", "Outcome_data.csv"),
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

str(Outcome) # 413 obs. of 64 variables

```


## 2 Define variable types

```{r variable, include = TRUE}

Outcome <- Outcome %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Case, NEW_CASE_CODE, QCODE), as.character),
    
    across(c(AGS, BLDLOSS, BMI, CATHPERIOD, FUPm, HOSPTIME,OPRTIME,
             UTIpostopFup, UTIpostopT), as.numeric),
    
    across(c(ANASTOMO,BLDCOMPLEAK,BLDCOMPRETN,BLDCOMPVOID,BLDSPASM,CATH,Center,
             CLAVIENCLASS,EPIDURAL,GENDER, GU30, GU90, GUER30, GUER90, HEMAT, 
             HISTOINJ,ILEUS, INCCOMPBLEED, INCCOMPINF, INCCOMPSCAR, NARC, 
             NONARC, PAIN, PREOPEPISODEn, PREOPRNPLN, PREOPRNSCR, PREOPTYPEUn,
             PREOPVURGRADE, PROC365, STENT, SURGIND, SURGTECHn2, TRTn2, UDR7M,
             URCOMPCVUR, URCOMPINJ, URCOMPOBST, URCOMPSTEN, UTIpostop, VURPHASE,
             VURRECG01, VURSIDE, REC011), as.factor)
  )

# remaining variables in the dataset: VURREC, VURRECGRADE, DOWNGRAD1M, DOWNGRAD3M, DOWNGRAD1Y, DOWNGRAD2Y, DOWNGRAD3Y, DOWNGRAD5Y, DOWNGRAD10Y
``` 

## 3 Imputation for missing values using KNN (k-nearest neighbors)

```{r imputation, include = TRUE}

# Subset the data to include only the required variables
subset <- Outcome[, c("BMI", "AGS", "PREOPVURGRADE", "PREOPRNSCR", 
                        "UDR7M", "GENDER", "VURPHASE", "PREOPTYPEUn", 
                        "PREOPEPISODEn", "PREOPRNPLN")]

# Calculate the percentage of missing values for each variable
missing <- colSums(is.na(subset)) / nrow(subset) * 100
print(missing)
            
# Perform kNN imputation on the selected variables using k=5, as it's a common default
imputed <- kNN(subset, k = 5)

# Combine imputed variables back into the original data if needed
Outcome[, colnames(subset)] <- imputed[, colnames(subset)]

# Calculate the percentage of missing values for each variable in the original data
missing2 <- colSums(is.na(Outcome)) / nrow(Outcome) * 100
print(missing2)

```


## 4 Descriptive analysis for numeric variables

```{r descriptivenum}

# Non-stratified statistics - Original Cohort

num_vars <- names(Outcome)[sapply(Outcome, is.numeric)]

summarize_numeric <- function(x){
  x <- na.omit(x)
  n <- length(x)
  
  if(n < 3) return(data.frame(N_available=n, Mean_SD=NA, Median_IQR=NA, Normality=NA))
  
  shapiro_p <- shapiro.test(x)$p.value
  normal <- shapiro_p > 0.05
  
  if(normal){
    Mean_SD <- paste0(round(mean(x),2), " ± ", round(sd(x),2))
    Median_IQR <- NA
  } else {
    Mean_SD <- NA
    Median_IQR <- paste0(round(median(x),2), " (", 
                         round(quantile(x,0.25),2), "-", 
                         round(quantile(x,0.75),2), ")")
  }
  
  data.frame(N_available=n, Mean_SD, Median_IQR, Normality=normal, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

table1 <- lapply(Outcome[num_vars], summarize_numeric) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "Variable")
table1
write.csv(table1, "output/Outcome_numeric.csv", row.names=FALSE)



# Stratified statistics by surgical technique (TRTn2) - Original Cohort

num_vars <- names(Outcome)[sapply(Outcome, is.numeric)]

summarize_numeric <- function(x){
  x <- na.omit(x)
  n <- length(x)
  
  if(n < 3) return(c(N= n, Mean_SD=NA, Median_IQR=NA, Normality=NA))
  
  shapiro_p <- shapiro.test(x)$p.value
  normal <- shapiro_p > 0.05
  
  if(normal){
    Mean_SD <- paste0(round(mean(x),2), " ± ", round(sd(x),2))
    Median_IQR <- NA
  } else {
    Mean_SD <- NA
    Median_IQR <- paste0(round(median(x),2), " (",
                         round(quantile(x,0.25),2), "-",
                         round(quantile(x,0.75),2), ")")
  }
  
  c(N=n, Mean_SD=Mean_SD, Median_IQR=Median_IQR, Normality=normal)
}


table1_by_trt <- Outcome %>%
  group_by(TRTn2) %>%
  reframe(
    across(all_of(num_vars), summarize_numeric),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


table1_by_trt <- Outcome %>%
  group_by(TRTn2) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(num_vars), summarize_numeric), .groups = "drop")
  bind_rows()

write.csv(table1_by_trt, "output/Outcome_numeric_strat.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```

## 5 Descriptive analysis for categorical variables

```{r descriptivecat}

# Non-stratified statistics - Original Cohort

factor_vars <- names(Outcome)[sapply(Outcome, is.factor)]

cat_summary <- function(x, varname) {
  x_nonmiss <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n_available <- length(x_nonmiss)
  t <- table(x_nonmiss)
  if(length(t) == 0) return(NULL)
  p <- round(prop.table(t) * 100, 1)
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = varname,
    Category = names(t),
    n = as.vector(t),
    Percent = as.vector(p),
    N_available = n_available,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cat_results <- lapply(factor_vars, function(var) {
  cat_summary(Outcome[[var]], var)
})

factor_table <- do.call(rbind, cat_results)
factor_table
write.csv(factor_table, "output/Outcome_factors.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```
